answer: Here is one concrete wall: Telescope maker sextant arc seal attested by the meridian office. It works because each sextant arc is a measured star position plus a guild signature, so a farm must grind a hundred real lenses by hand, and the mirror it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the orchard is that the farm's unit economics never work. The reef is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
